description: HELD-OUT routing set 2. Labelled by retrieval need BEFORE the router was run on it and before the rules it checks were changed; never used to tune rules. Do not edit labels after a run; add new cases instead. Includes deliberate look-alikes (a noun 'operators', a noun 'reference', a supplier inside a company name) to catch false positives of the rules written from set 1's misses.
